title: K1380 stage 3/3: QLIKE + sanity gate + White RC + Hansen SPA

claude_followup.brief:
K1380 stage 3 has produced experiments/k1380/k1380_results.json. Write the Paper 9
(garch-x-vix) "Multiple Testing Considerations" subsection from it.

PREREQUISITE — check first, do not skip:
  jq -r '.status, .sanity_gate.passed' experiments/k1380/k1380_results.json
If status != "OK" or sanity_gate.passed != true, STOP. Write nothing to the paper,
open a debug task quoting .diagnosis and .observed_mean_qlike, and report. Mean QLIKE
must be on the ~1.4 scale of K1379; the discarded 2026-07-16 run sat at 620-740
because QLIKE was reversed, and its conclusion (SPA p=1.000, "no spec beats GJR")
is withdrawn and must never be cited.

WHAT TO WRITE
Target: paper/garch-x-vix/main.tex, existing \subsection{Multiple Testing
Considerations} placeholder (~line 813, currently two Bonferroni sentences).
Expand to: the SPA/RC results table, the excluded/flagged spec note, and the
economic reading. Report from the JSON:
  - .white_rc_test           White (2000) RC = max studentised advantage over all
                             16 candidates at the least-favourable configuration
  - .hansen_spa_test         p_consistent is primary; p_lower/p_upper bracket it
  - .individual_dm_stats     per-spec t-stats, explicitly NOT snooping-adjusted
  - .holm_stepdown           Holm-adjusted one-sided p-values
  - .block_length_sensitivity and .excluding_flagged_specs as robustness
  - .a4f_focus.attains_spa_max  does A4f attain the maximum, or another spec?

BOTH DIRECTIONS ARE PUBLISHABLE, and the wording differs:
  - If A4f survives the correction, say so plainly and keep the existing claims.
  - If it does NOT, say so plainly AND soften the MCS/DM wording elsewhere in the
    body in the same edit, so the paper does not assert in one section what it
    retracts in another. Do not bury an overturning result in a footnote.

MUST ALSO DISCLOSE — read .candidate_set_integrity:
A1/A3, A2/A2n and A4/A4n emit bit-identical forecasts; the code configures each
pair identically, so Table 1's tau-timing and sample-mean-normalisation
distinctions are not implemented. The p-value is unaffected (a duplicate cannot
raise a maximum), but the paper must not describe the search as covering more
distinct models than were estimated. State the distinct count.
Also note C1 was absent entirely from the 2026-07-16 run (its fixed-span lag
matrix was built with Km+1 monthly rows and silently fell below a >=10 guard), so
that run's "17-spec" race actually ranked 13.

CONSTRAINTS
- Main thread writes the .tex; do NOT delegate paper body writing to a background
  agent (.claude/rules/paper-workflow.md).
- Every number must come from the results JSON. No recomputation by hand, no
  rounding that changes a significance verdict.
- Pass the finance-paper-quality claim-evidence gate before compiling.
- Then: xelatex -> uv run volpred ops paper-update --paper-id <id>, per
  .claude/skills/paper-update/SKILL.md.
- knowledge.json is written by the MAIN THREAD only, never by an agent (K1259).
  Reviewer provenance note: Codex was out of credits on 2026-07-21, so the code
  review was a feature-dev:code-reviewer subagent fallback. Re-verify via
  primary-path Codex before writing a PASS verdict to knowledge.json.
